summary: DevRelay 0.10.0-rc.1 has a strong deterministic lifecycle, exact artifact lineage, gates, checkpoints, replay, and traceability, but several ecosystem adapters are contract-defined or fixture-conformant rather than live-attested. V0.11 improves requirements depth and live integration without changing Core authority.
stakeholders: Module, adapter, pack, and skill authors
Godot developers using the optional domain pack
domainConstraints: The released V1 lifecycle sequence and Gate ownership remain authoritative.
TraceabilityGraph remains cross-cutting and only trusted contributors may propose validated graph updates.
Domain-specific behavior belongs in optional packs and adapters, not Generic Core.
Project-local provider acquisition is checksum-pinned and requires explicit first-download approval.
Raw receipts remain local; Git contains digest-bound redacted evidence only.
Provider compatibility and maturity claims require exact live evidence.
conventions: Use immutable Module, adapter, strategy, policy, and compatibility-matrix versions.
Run all released Modules in lifecycle order and append each completed improvement before using the circuit for the next improvement.
Use breadth-first clarification waves and preserve question, answer, coverage, conflict, and closure artifacts.
Distinguish contract-defined, fixture-conformant, live-conformant, release-ready, and unavailable maturity honestly.
Keep Codex skills thin over released DevRelay operations and store them under .agents/skills.
